metadata.description: A connected suite of five Agent Skills for worldbuilding: gradual development, world systems and simulation, living canon, conlang design, and evidence-first research.

plugins.name: worldbuilding-suite
plugins.description: All five worldbuilding skills, installable in one step. Provides gradual-worldbuilding (pace and stage-gates), storycraft-os (systems and simulation), living-canon-os (canon storage and transactions), conlang-design (constructed languages), and worldbuilding-research (evidence-first research).
